patterns.name: Create Reusable Cleanup Agent
patterns.description: Create standalone cleanup prompt with comprehensive workflows for ongoing workspace maintenance
patterns.context: When workspace accumulates build artifacts, temporary files, and documentation sprawl

steps: Step 1: Analyze workspace for cleanup targets (build artifacts, temp files, docs, key streams)
Step 2: Create .github/prompts/cleanup.prompt.md with target-specific cleanup logic
Step 3: Add safety mechanisms (checkpoint commits, dry-run mode, archive-instead-of-delete)
Step 4: Implement validation to ensure cleanup doesn't break builds
Step 5: Add reporting to track cleanup statistics

examples.description: Created cleanup.prompt.md and executed first comprehensive workspace cleanup

patterns.name: Key Data Stream Consolidation
patterns.description: Merge related key data streams to reduce prompts.keys footprint while preserving complete history
patterns.context: When multiple completed keys address the same component or feature area

steps: Step 1: Identify completed keys with similar scope (3+ keys on same component)
Step 2: Merge work logs chronologically preserving all entries
Step 3: Combine file mappings into unified list
Step 4: Preserve all git commit SHAs from merged keys
Step 5: Archive original keys to _archived/consolidated-{date}/
Step 6: Update consolidated key with merged functionality registry

examples.description: Enhanced cleanup.prompt.md with key consolidation logic and stale key detection

patterns.name: Archive Before Deletion Pattern
patterns.description: Archive files to timestamped directories before deletion to enable recovery and historical reference
patterns.context: When cleaning up old summaries, dated files, or uncertain content

steps: Step 1: Create archive directory with timestamp: Workspaces/Archive/{date}/
Step 2: Move (not delete) target files to archive directory
Step 3: Preserve directory structure in archive
Step 4: Verify files archived successfully before proceeding
Step 5: Document archive location in cleanup report

examples.description: Archived 10+ old summaries and cohesion reviews to Workspaces/Archive/2025-10-12-pre-cleanup/

patterns.name: Root Directory Minimalism
patterns.description: Keep root directory minimal with only essential config files, relocate everything else to appropriate subdirectories
patterns.context: When root directory accumulates scripts, documentation, and temporary files

steps: Step 1: Define essential root files (.gitignore, .sln, Directory.Build.props, package.json)
Step 2: Move PowerShell scripts to Scripts/
Step 3: Move documentation to Workspaces/Documentation/
Step 4: Move configuration files to config/
Step 5: Verify build still works after relocation

examples.description: Reduced root directory from 14 files to 5 essential config files
